boundary.description: By the River Irk from Cheetham Hill Road to and along the Manchester-Bury Metrolink line to Smedley Lane. By Smedley Lane to the River Irk and along the River Irk to a point opposite the northern boundary of Manchester General cemetery. By the cemetery boundary to Rochdale Road. Along Rochdale Road and Carisbrook Street to the bend nearest Moston Brook. Then by a beeline to and along Moston Brook to Church Lane. Along Church Lane, Thorpe Road, Oldham Road, and by the railway line to and along the Rochdale Canal to a point opposite Poland Street and by a beeline to and along Poland Street, Oldham Road, Swan Street and Miller Street and Cheetham Hill Road to the River Irk.
